Mosport survey

Circuit mosport (Canadian Tire Motorsport Park, Bowmanville, Ontario) · Canadian GP · Canada · theme green, classic, clockwise, night:false, lamp:"none".
Branch cursor/mosport-survey-a1 · base sha 432d348 (merged shared-shot-tooling-5b45 and day-wet-lighting-b7b8, both clean) · surveyed 2026-10-15 · read-only on js/ and css/.

Measured = computed from the built centreline or seen in a capture. Source claim = stated in a brief or code comment, not independently verified. Everything else is labelled a guess.

Summary

  • 72 frames captured on TLX/SwiftShader (6 lap positions): dry-day orbit, eye and trackside; wet, rain, overcast, fog and storm at day; dry and rain at dusk and night. All 6 audit checks and verify-track pass.
  • Geometry is sound and matches the named OSM corners. The visible problems are all dressing and atmosphere: wide bare-dirt verges, thin-looking armco, an open treeless Moss, flat tan horizon hills, and overcast/fog leaving the sky blue.
  • Top defects are at the end of this page with file:line; none were applied.

Real-world cross-checks (source claims, not re-verified here): brief cites Wikipedia and CTMP facilities for Moss T5a/5b, Mario Andretti Straightaway and the 2013 Event Centre, and notes the closed Mosport Speedway oval is outside the road course. The def comment says OSM stitched 3957 m against 3948 m projected. Treat brief fractions as measured-by-OSM, not photographed.

Ranked defects (not applied)

1. Wide bare tan verges contradict “almost no run-off, sandy shoulders”. Seen in frames 02, 03, 08, 14, 06. ~20 m of tan dirt on both sides everywhere. Mechanism: the circuit pal (js/circuits/mosport.js:56-66) never sets runoff, so the engine default [0.55,0.42,0.28] (js/track/core/def.js:19) is graded to grass across the terrain ribbon (js/track/core/mesh.js:1064, MAT.ROCK for the inner 22%). Fix: set a grass-leaning or sandy-green runoff in pal (e.g. close to SAND [0.66,0.58,0.42] blended toward [0.30,0.42,0.22]) and verify the ribbon width against §2/§5.
2. Overcast and fog leave the sky saturated blue. Frames 31-42 vs 19-30 and 43-48. Fog only hazes the near ground. Mechanism (suspected, one circuit surveyed): mosport day|dry boosts daySkyBlue 1.06 (js/lighting/presets.js:7254); day|overcast only sets cloudCover 0.32 (7256) and day|fog has no sky term (7255); atmosphere.js overcasts the sky for wet/rain only (js/lighting/atmosphere.js:355, and 380 treats overcast/fog separately). Probably engine-wide, so confirm on a second circuit before fixing. Fix: raise cloudCover/sky mute in these two presets or extend the overcast branch to sky colour.
3. Horizon hills render as flat tan slabs, not wooded ridges. Dry/fog day frames 03, 06, 39 (a pale beige plateau on the horizon; dark under rain). Mechanism (guess): farHill passes forest:[0.16,0.30,0.18] and snowline:2 (mosport.js:541-549) but the rendered colour matches the runoff tan, so the mountain likely takes the terrain/runoff colour rather than the forest tint. Fix: check how mountain() consumes forest and whether the 1.1-1.4 km hills sit inside the graded ribbon; 1 mountain was also dropped by the scenery guard (verify warning).
4. Moss is open and treeless; the brief wants the lowest, most enclosed part of the lap. Frame 04, 17, 52, 64. Mechanism: near wood is deliberately omitted at Moss because the hairpin folds -1 trees into the +1 bank (mosport.js:324-326, indexSolid 0.465-0.510), the side gate removes wood at 0.455-0.520 (line 486), and the far belts sit 72-92 m out. The seat-tier bank (288-330) is not visible in orbit frames; the coloured boards that read as the Moss feature are sponsorHoarding(0.47,0.505,+1,18) (321) and look like a floating fence. Fix: bring a mid-distance belt (gap 40-55) back on -1 and give the +1 hoarding a ground-level footing or remove it.
5. Armco is nearly invisible. Only thin dark ribbons at the treeline (frames 08, 14); nothing hugging the road. Mechanism (uncertain): guardrail gaps are 10.5-14 m from centreline (lines 193-516), i.e. 4-7.5 m beyond the edge, behind the bare verge; the full-lap -1 run (515) at 13 m may be hidden under the terrain ribbon or too low-poly to read at orbit range. Fix: inspect a close eye shot at one corner; if rails are at ground level the gap/height needs checking against the terrain ribbon (terrainYAt).
6. Mixed woodland reads as mostly pyramid conifers plus yellow/orange umbrella crowns. Frames 02, 08, 14. Brief wants broadleaf + conifer, summer green; code colours broadleaf LEAF [0.24,0.42,0.18] (mosport.js:68-72, mixedTree 112-120), yet crowns render yellow-orange, which reads as autumn. Mechanism (guess): furniture.fol [0.22,0.40,0.20] and the tree:"broad" kit (mosport.js:85) plus the sun-tint (tint -0.12 in day|dry preset, 7254) shift greens toward yellow. Fix: check the broadleaf crown shader tint and the preset tint/ambTemp.
7. Leafless bare trunks beside the road. Frames 10, 14. Mechanism (unverified): trees dropped by the guard (verify-track: suppressed tree=155) may leave trunks without crowns, or deferred plantTree crowns are skipped. Fix: list the 155 guard drops and confirm trunk/crown are dropped together.
8. Night/dusk light pools with no source. Frames 50-54, 61-72: big soft orange blobs on the verge, black sky with no stars or horizon glow, while the circuit has lamp:"none" (mosport.js:85). Likely a global fill or car light; not circuit data. Night race lighting is only authored for night:true circuits, so this may be by design. Fix: trace the light source in js/lighting/presets.js mosport|night entries before dressing it.
9. Elevation shape differs from the brief. Built relief 40.8 m with a shelf at f 0.19-0.31 and the line not the summit (see table). Mechanism: SRTM bake, circuit-elevations.js:17. Fix: either amend docs/tracks/mosport.md §3 to the measured numbers or re-bake; do not flatten terrain.
10. Rain reflections and a see-through tree. Frame 27 (smeared SSR on verge), frame 20 (left foreground tree translucent). Renderer-side (ssrWetMul 1.38 at presets.js:7257); not circuit data.
11. Camera artefacts. Frames 01, 13, 49, 55, 61, 67: orbit/trackside at the start sit on or behind the 128 m pit run. Not a geometry bug; choose another frac or --through for start shots.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the matrix: dawn; eye and trackside cameras outside dry day; fog and storm at dusk/night; frac positions beyond the six (no frames at the pit exit, Whites tunnel, Event Centre or footbridges close-up; the Whites tunnel, Event Centre and Moss seat bank were never seen close).
  • Every frame is TLX on SwiftShader (no GPU). WGX and GLX were not compared, so backend-specific defects are unknown.
  • Nothing here is evidence about a player's GPU. Frame reads are visual impressions from downscaled stills, not pixel assertions; I did not drive a lap, so motion artefacts (z-fighting, shimmer) are unassessed. coplanar-audit reports 0 spots.
  • Defects 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 and 8 name a likely mechanism that I did not confirm by editing; the “uncertain” labels stand.
  • Gallery build (node tools/track/build-gallery.cjs --out=scratch/gallery-out --no-fetch, run after pushing): all 72 Mosport frames appear (144 manifest entries, i.e. each frame is listed twice, cause not traced). Two tooling issues: --help documents --out DIR but only --out=DIR works (the spaced form silently overwrote tracked gallery/tracks/, which I restored); and storm is missing from WEATHER_TAIL/TOD_PREFIX (tools/track/build-gallery.cjs:41, survey-gallery-lib.cjs:9), so storm frames parse as tod “unknown” with the tod left in the sector name.
  • Real-world dimensions are source claims from the brief; no external web verification was done in this pass.
